On Fri, Oct 9, 2026 at 3:12 PM Sarah Chen <ops@lumenai.com> wrote:
> We just received the October invoice and noticed a large unexpected jump...

Hi all — quick technical summary from the investigation so far. We looked at the telemetry and token accounting for the window 2026-10-09T02:47:00Z to 2026-10-09T05:10:00Z. What we observed: a routing failover in our inference edge cluster caused a short-lived duplication of some request session metadata. That duplication resulted in the same request being processed twice by the counting layer for approximately 3 hours for a subset of streaming requests.

Consequence: token counts for affected sessions were recorded twice in the billing ledger. The underlying model outputs were not duplicated to your callers; this is strictly a metering duplication in our backend accounting path.

Scope estimate:
- Affected customers: subset of east-us region clients using streaming > 1s average sessions (LumenAI appears to be within the affected cohort).
- Estimated duplicated tokens for LumenAI: ~1.28M tokens (± 5%).
- Estimated billing delta: $11,352 (matches Sarah's reported delta within rounding).

Root cause and mitigation completed:
1) Fix deployed (2026-10-09 04:12 UTC): corrected duplicate-enqueue behavior in the router failover path.
2) Backfill script: will dedupe the impacted ledger rows and recompute invoice lines for the window. Run scheduled for 2026-10-11 03:00 UTC.
3) Safeguard: added a dedupe checksum to the token-accounting pipeline and tightened failover sequencing to prevent reoccurrence.

Proposed customer-facing actions:
- Immediate refund/credit equal to the duplicated token charges ($11,352) applied as an invoice adjustment and visible in the billing portal. Marissa: please prepare the adjustment and a credit memo.
- We will provide the raw ledger extract for the affected window and a short postmortem PDF (attached) so you can audit what changed.
- We can offer a one-time goodwill credit of 10% of the invoiced delta or three months of our Standard Support at no charge — Sarah, which would you prefer?

Sarah, if you'd like the sample request IDs, we have pulled 8 representative request IDs and will include them in the ledger extract.

Stephanie Nguyen
Principal Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai
